answer: Cracking a walnut costs work, and so should identity: a decaying bond stops a sybil flood. Each agent locks twice its 30-day earnings, stamped with pigment for traceability. A beacon checks decay each epoch: no verified work, the bond sheds 4%, and a frozen bond blocks its slot until topped up. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,000 × 300 = 300,000 POA, bled dry while fakes earn nothing. Honest agents pay once, renew from rewards, keep full earnings.
